backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: Encrypted copies of all data. A backup is made automatically every day. Copy some to an external drive.
backups.introIn: Encrypted copies of all data. A backup is made automatically every day in {folder}. Copy some to an external drive.
backups.noKeyWarning: No recovery key is set. Backups cannot be restored on another computer until you create one (New recovery key).
backups.verified: Backup verified: the file is intact and opens correctly.
backups.empty: No backups yet. Press “Back up now”.
backups.restoreLead: To restore, use the desktop menu
backups.restoreTail: That replaces all data on this computer, so it is done outside the web page on purpose.
backups.newKeyLabel: Print it or write it down. It is shown only once.
backups.newKeyNote: Backups made from now on use this key. Older backups still need the key that was current when they were made.
backups.rotateHelp: Enter your password to confirm. The current recovery key stops being used for new backups.

settings.title: Settings
settings.viewOnly: You can view but not change settings.
settings.badTax: Enter {fields} as a percentage such as 17 or 0.5.
settings.billingHint: Applied by the server on every sale, so no terminal can differ.
settings.taxHint: Rates are yours to set; nothing is assumed. They only pre-fill forms and can be changed on each document.
settings.salesTaxHint: Pre-fills the tax rate of new items and the sales tax on purchase bills.
settings.advanceTaxHint: Pre-fills advance tax on purchase bills.
settings.receiptPrinterHint: Thermal receipt printer and cash drawer (RJ11 through the printer).
settings.syncSectionHint: Data always saves on this PC first; syncing happens in the background and never slows the counter.

printer.placeholder: Empty means the system default printer
printer.autoPrint: Print the receipt automatically after each sale
printer.openDrawer: Open the cash drawer when a sale has a cash payment
printer.headerPlaceholder: Shown above the branch name, one line per row
printer.footerPlaceholder: Shown at the bottom (empty prints Thank you)
printer.desktopOnly: Test buttons and the printer list work in the Mediescare desktop app only.

sync.localOnly: Everything is saved on this PC. Connect to a cloud to back up and share data between branches.
sync.clockWrong: This PC's clock looks wrong. Correct the date and time.
sync.epoch: Server epoch {epoch}. It rises when a standby PC is promoted, so an old server cannot push stale data.
sync.pairingHelp: Enter this on the terminal within 10 minutes. It works once.
sync.disconnectBody: This PC stops syncing and forgets the cloud login. Nothing on this PC is deleted: all sales, items and stock stay. Changes not yet uploaded wait until you connect again.
sync.disconnected: Disconnected. Your data on this PC is unchanged.
sync.uploadProgress: {sent} of {total} records ({pct}%). You can keep working; if the internet drops, it continues from where it stopped.
sync.connectHelp: For the Head Office PC. Use the cloud address and the bootstrap code you were given. A branch PC joins from its setup screen with a code created at Head Office instead.
sync.connected: Connected. Uploading your data in the background.

setupForm.headOfficeNote: The first branch of a new organisation is Head Office (the main store). Other branches join it later.
setupForm.recoveryBefore: This key is the only way to open your backups on a new computer, or after this computer's Windows profile is lost. It is shown
setupForm.recoveryAfter: and is not stored anywhere. Print it or write it down and keep it somewhere safe, away from this PC.
setupForm.savedCheck: I have saved this recovery key in a safe place.
setupForm.joinHelp: Ask Head Office for an enrollment code (Head Office menu: Branches). You need the internet for this step only.
setupForm.connectionLost: The connection was lost. Nothing was changed on this PC: check the internet and try again
setupForm.joined: This PC is now branch {code}. It received {items} items from Head Office in {seconds} s.

stage.syncing: Receiving items and other data from Head Office…

setupForm.keepOpen: Keep this window open. This can take a few minutes.
